story:
It was a sunny day at Springdale Elementary School. Soomin was excited to see his friends in the cafeteria during lunchtime. But, oh no! He couldn't find his brand-new, shiny red lunchbox anywhere!

"Help!" Soomin cried out loud. "My lunchbox is missing!"

Mrs. Thompson, their kind teacher, came over and gave Soomin a warm smile. "Don't worry, Soomin. We'll help you find it."

Soomin's friends, Emma and Max, gathered around him. "We'll search high and low!" said Emma. "But first, let's make a plan," added Max.

The three friends looked at each other and decided to ask their classmates if they had seen the lunchbox. They asked Mrs. Thompson's pet rabbit, Mr. Fluffers, if he had seen it too. But Mr. Fluffers just twitched his whiskers and said "Bunnies don't eat lunchboxes!"

As they searched the cafeteria, they met Olivia, who was eating a delicious-looking sandwich. "Yum! My turkey sandwich smells so good!" Soomin's tummy started to rumble.

But then they found a clue – a crumb on the floor with a tiny piece of red paper next to it. Emma exclaimed, "Look! It might be a trail leading us to the lost lunchbox!"

The friends followed the crumbs and paper strips through the playground, past the swings, and under the slide. Finally, they reached a small bench where Max's friend, Ava, was sitting with Soomin's lunchbox on her lap.

"Wow!" said Emma. "We found it!" The group cheered as Mrs. Thompson came over and gave them all high-fives.

Soomin hugged his friends. "Thanks for helping me find my lunchbox! You're the best friends ever!"

As they sat down to eat together, Soomin realized that he was not just happy about finding his lunchbox – he was also happy because he had shared it with his friends and they all worked together to solve the mystery.
